items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section III, List of Answers on Topics 32:1
items.html: By a coupling by striking at the ground of Atzilut the ten Sefirot of Beria emerged, and by a coupling by striking at the ground of Beria the ten Sefirot of Yetzira emerged. (Chapter 2, Item 2, and Inner Light, Item 3)
